anchors.context: Blaise / answer under pressure / René and Noor

anchors.context: René / ordinary unfinished work / Emil
anchors.text: “I was going to replace it.”

anchors.context: René / admission / Emil
anchors.text: “You would have stopped me.”

anchors.context: René / particular preparation / Blaise and Emil
anchors.text: “I cut it to the cord.”

anchors.context: René / defense of standing / both women and the gathering
anchors.text: “An earlier person isn't worth less because she wants something earlier.”

anchors.context: René / first-person objection / Blaise
anchors.text: “So would the person you met at supper.”

anchors.context: Emil / taking his food / Blaise
anchors.text: “Now it can come.”

anchors.context: Emil / interruption / Blaise and René
anchors.text: “I want to hear about the woman before he fixes you.”

anchors.context: Emil / an actual condition / René and the gathering
anchors.text: “I want to know whether this can be made to answer me. You don't get to keep saying I'm the reason before we've tried the part I asked for.”

anchors.context: Continuing Dora / present bodily loss / René
anchors.text: “The part that went through the room is gone,” the voice says. “I can feel where it used to answer. When you speak on that side I still turn toward it.”

anchors.context: Continuing Dora / exploration / René
anchors.text: “Then I want to find that out.”

anchors.context: Table Dora / disagreement about her picture / the other woman
anchors.text: “I didn't say I wouldn't.”

anchors.context: Table Dora / shared earlier bodily history / René
anchors.text: “Last time you did mine, I kept answering while it changed,” the standing woman says.

anchors.context: Table Dora / present wishes / René and the gathering
anchors.text: “I want my picture where people can see it. I want to go back and decide whether it's finished. I want her to keep going if that's what she's doing.”

anchors.context: Noor / an offered procedure / Blaise
anchors.text: “I can keep an outside path answering with you. We'll have to inspect the edge first.”

anchors.context: Alma / her own occasion / the arriving group
anchors.text: “Then don't finish them.”

anchors.context: Basil / rehearsal pressure / Blaise
anchors.text: “There are two pages after that,” he says. “Don't spend all of it here.”
